title: Paralelizace
text: Jakmile tool iteruje N>1 nezavislych zdroju (repozitare, soubory, API), pouzij ThreadPoolExecutor. Pocet workeru: min(4, N). I/O-bound operace skaluiji lineerne do ~8 vlaken.

title: Casove konstanty
text: Subprocess timeout v MCP toolu musi byt max 25% MCP client timeoutu. Client timeout 60s = subprocess timeout 15s. Fail fast, fail loud.

title: Read-only locky
text: Kazdy read-only subprocess call (git, grep, diff) pouzivej ['git', '--no-optional-locks']. Eliminuje filesystem lock contention.

title: JSON defenziva
text: Kazdy JSON state deserializer: try/except + isinstance(v, dict) guard + auto-repair. Pocitej s corrupt daty.

title: Diagnostika
text: @auditable na kazdem toolu. Povinne: ts, tool, duration_s, ok. Bez metriky neni diagnostika.

title: Timeout guard
text: I/O tool s potencialem >10s = wrapper s concurrent.futures.TimeoutError.

title: Zadne CSS tridy v selektorech
text: Pouzivej semanticke HTML atributy (href, aria-label, role). CSS tridy jsou ephemeral — A/B testy je meni bez varovani.

title: Console script distribution
text: Po uv sync vzdy overuj, ze konzolovy script je dostupny. Pokud where selze pridej .venv/Scripts do PATH nebo vytvor .bat wrapper.

title: Long-running batch operations
text: MCP neni bezny REST API — je to vnorovana i/o smycka s presne jednim klientem. Synchronni batch = blokujici STDIO = timeout klienta = ztrata prace.

title: Windows path quoting
text: Na Windows: vzdy quotuj cesty s mezerami v subprocess volani. PowerShell: & 'path with spaces.exe'. Bash (Git Bash): 'C:/path with spaces/file'. Spravna citace muze zmenit exit code z 1 na 0.

title: Workspace context export
text: tool_workspace_info() pri startu serveru + workspace root do stderr. LLM nema mechanismus jak zjistit ALLOWED_ROOTS.

title: Console encoding na Windows
text: Na Windows: PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8' + chcp 65001 pred spustenim Python skriptu. Bez toho: UnicodeEncodeError na diakritice a specialnich znacich.

title: Windows encoding: PYTHONIOENCODING + PYTHONUTF8 + -X utf8
text: Tri vrstvy UTF-8: (1) $env:PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8', (2) $env:PYTHONUTF8=1, (3) python -X utf8. Kazda kryje jine scenario.

title: LLM response format fallback
text: msg.get('content') or msg.get('reasoning') pro kazdeho providera. Ruzni LLM poskytovatele maji rozdilne response struktury.

title: Deterministicke kroky cacheovat
text: Pokud krok neni nahodny (napr. Stockfish analyza), cacheuj vysledek. Re-run 5 her z cache = 0.1s misto 24 minut.

title: Dvourovnova LLM cache
text: Level 1: full LLM response (hodnota). Level 2: structured parse (hra+barva+profil). Klic: {game_id}_{color}_llm.json.

title: Cross-LLM audit gate
text: Pred major release: v1 twin scan + v2 code review. Cross-LLM audit = povinna brana.

title: Silent except je bug
text: except Exception: pass neni ochrana — je to maskovani problemu. Kazdy except musi logovat nebo propoustet.

title: getattr s defaultem maskuje neexistujici atributy
text: getattr(obj, 'field', default) na LLM response = ticha data degradace. Default = warning, ne ticha nahrada.

title: Nazvy souboru/adresaru jen ASCII
text: Vsechny nazvy souboru/adresaru ASCII [A-Za-z0-9._-]. Overeni .scripts/ascii_filenames_check.ps1 (exit 0).

title: Scraping pipeline s detail fetch = 3 faze
text: Collect URLs -> Parallel fetch details -> Filter/merge. Kazda faze ma vlastni error handling.

title: 0 karet na strance N>1 = end-of-list, ne layout change
text: Pokud search vrati 0 vysledku na strance N>1, je to normalni end-of-list, ne chyba layoutu.

title: Pri 403 v GCP overit vsech 5 autentizacnich vrstev
text: IAM role -> Access Scope -> Metadata Server identity -> Workspace vs Cloud scope mismatch -> Service Account quota.

title: Hard Reset protokol
text: Pri zacykleni v chybach >30 minut: smazat poskozeny soubor -> vlozit overeny blok kodu -> smazat data -> zacit z nuly.
